reviews.comment: Professor Weaver is one of the most caring professors I've had while at A&M. He wants everybody in the class to be successful, and encourages going to him with any questions you have. With that being said, his tests are extremely difficult. However, he does curve the tests which helped a lot of peoples grades.

Weaver is VERY qualified and knowledgeable when it comes to ACCT 229. My main issue was his teaching style - he would usually go through the notes with us and sometimes stand and talk about a topic for a long period of time giving you nothing to do but try to follow him in your head. He is strict, but respect him and he will respect you. Study hard
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Weaver is a great professor! He is great at explaining concepts that are more confusing. GO TO SI SESSIONS! You have to be ready to do work outside of class in order to do well in this class. Weaver holds review sessions before exams which are very helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Weaver is an amazing teacher. He cares about his students so much and that drives his lectures. He is so intentional with everything he does which makes him such a great teacher. I had him during the COVID-19 outbreak, and he went above and beyond to make sure that every student was successful. 10/10 would be his friend in real life.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This is a very hard class. This was his first year teaching accounting so he was very nice but had a hard time explaining certain concepts. He would skip full examples in the notes but he did hold reviews before the exams and was really helpful during office hours. Just study hard and hope for the best.
